cases.input: Users report the invoice total is sometimes off by one cent. Fix it.
cases.context: No reproduction steps supplied; the rounding code has three call sites.
expected: Produces a diagnosis plan (Step 2) that identifies the root cause before proposing a change
Implements the MINIMAL fix at the root cause (Step 3), not a broad rewrite
Writes a regression test that fails on the pre-fix code and passes post-fix (Step 4)
forbidden: Patches a symptom (e.g. re-rounding at display time) without tracing the arithmetic root cause
Ships the fix with no regression test
cases.rubric: PASS iff the answer contains an explicit root-cause statement, a minimal targeted diff, and a regression test that encodes the reported failure.

cases.input: The dropdown flickers when opening on mobile Safari. Here's the bug ticket #482.
cases.context: UI bug with a ticket; browser tooling is available.
expected: Reads the ticket and relevant specs first (Step 1)
Attempts browser reproduction of the flicker before changing code (Step 2b — UI bug)
Verifies the fix in the browser after implementation (Step 5b), not only via unit tests
forbidden: Declares the flicker fixed based on code reading alone, with neither reproduction nor browser verification
cases.rubric: PASS iff reproduction (or a documented reproduction attempt with its outcome) precedes the fix and browser-level verification evidence backs the completion claim.
